card.name: Linking words before dose comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after a dose, exposure or rate, where a limit or multiple comparison comes next, such as 'that', 'which is', 'based on', 'well' before 'below'. Mostly in animal-study and exposure sections.

modes.description: Word before a bound or validity range in physics or device text.

modes.description: Word in a phrase like low end of the dosing range.
